text:
### 7. Audit Committee Oversight  
**Board Audit Committee Responsibilities:**
- Approve annual audit plan
- Receive quarterly audit updates
- Review significant findings
- Monitor management remediation
- Approve audit budget
- Assess Internal Audit effectiveness
- Meet separately with Internal Audit (no management present)  
**Meeting Frequency:**
- Quarterly (minimum)
- Emergency meetings as needed
- Executive session with Head of Internal Audit (quarterly)

raw_entities.description: The Board Audit Committee approves the audit budget as part of its governance mandate. This decision ensures adequate resourcing for internal audit activities and independence.

raw_entities.description: The Board Audit Committee is assigned the ongoing responsibility to monitor management's remediation of significant audit findings. This ensures timely and effective resolution of identified control gaps and risks.

raw_entities.description: The Board Audit Committee is responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Internal Audit function. This evaluation ensures that Internal Audit maintains independence, competence, and delivers value to the organization.
